newsitem.title: USA: BASF unit holds 5.17 pct IVAX stake.
newsitem.headline: BASF unit holds 5.17 pct IVAX stake.

text.p: BASFIN Corp, a U.S. unit of BASF A.G., said Friday it has acquired a 5.17 percent stake or 6,284,700 common shares in IVAX Corp.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, BASFIN said it paid $158.3 million for the stake. It said it first acquired shares in IOVAS in connection with the formation in March 1995 of Knoll Norton GmbH, a joint venture between an IVAX subsidiary and Knoll AG, a unif of BASF.

Latest transactions include the purchase of 484,700 common shares of IVAX between September 20 and October 1 for $7.41 million. The shares were purchased because the BASF group thinks they are an "attractive investment," according to the filing.
